Atlantic Canada's science powerhouse
Excellence in academics, student experience, and research
Dalhousie University in Halifax, Canada is Atlantic Canada’s top research university and one of the most respected science universities in Canada. With the Atlantic Ocean at our doorstep, our unique blend of academic programs, pioneering research, and a collaborative approach makes an impact on our local, national, and global communities.
Faculty of Science students are encouraged to grow their strengths and passion for science into a university experience rich with exploration, experimentation, skill-building and scientific knowledge.
Contact the Faculty of Science
Teaching
Dalhousie's Faculty of Science offers a comprehensive mix of undergraduate and graduate science programs to ensure a unique path for every individual student. Our award-winning science professors are committed to your education with a focus on providing you with an experiential and hands-on learning experience.
Discover the program that fits your passion
Research
As one of Canada’s top research-intensive universities, Dalhousie’s Faculty of Science offers countless research opportunities for students. Our internationally recognized scholars conduct over $45 million in annual research funding and make a strong impact on our local, regional and global landscape.
Meet the people who make science happen
Community
Dalhousie University Science faculty, staff, students, friends, supporters and alumni work in collaboration with many different organizations in the community and are actively sharing their passion and knowledge. Together, we play an integral role in making a difference in our province, our country, and all over the world.
See more from the Dal Science community
Information for new applicants:
Students: Advisors in the Faculty of Science are spread across all of our programs and can help you with any questions about your academic journey.
Book an advising appointment (login required)
International Applicants: Immigration advisors in Dal's International Centre can help you navigate the permits and visas you need to live, work, and study in Canada.
Visit the International Centre's website
New Undergraduate Students: Did you know you can begin your science degree on Dalhousie's Truro campus before coming to Halifax in your second year?
Learn more about the Truro Start Program

Faculty and Staff
Our faculty and staff members are instrumental members of the Dal Science community and are the key to delivering some of the best science programs in Canada. Over 250 faculty and staff members are spread across our 19 programs, 8 departments and dozens of research units.
